mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds Rate above 5.25% in a given month coincides with a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to higher discount rates eroding expected equity payoffs.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from a pre-tightening baseline (p > 0.05) in the same month regime.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in PAYEMS (labor market employment) of at least 10,000 accompanied by a simultaneous decline in UNRATE (unemployment rate) below 4.5% signals a strengthening labor market, which precedes a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative despite the labor signal persists for ≥3 months; or unemployment remains above 5% during the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly surge in HOUST (residential building permits) exceeding 1,500 units while GDP deflator (CPIAUCSL) remains flat for two consecutive months predicts a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as it signals sustained demand momentum.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > 1,500 AND CPIAUCSL unchanged for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative or insignificant; permits revert to trend within one month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly INDPRO (industrial production) index falling below 105 while UNRATE rises above 5.5% indicates a supply-side shock that depresses corporate earnings expectations and produces a negative 5-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero in the same month; or INDPRO recovers without a sustained UNRATE increase.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS for three consecutive months without a compensating rise in GDP deflator (CPIAUCSL) predicts a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as investors anticipate looser policy and higher equity valuations.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS falls for three consecutive months AND CPIAUCSL does not rise for three consecutive months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain negative; or FEDFUNDS recovers before the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly PAYEMS reading above 140,000 in the absence of a UNRATE decline below 4%, indicates a labor market overheating that precedes a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive despite persistent strong labor readings; or unemployment falls below 3.5% during the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A one-time monthly spike in GDPC1 (real private consumption) exceeding 2% of the prior month's value in a deflationary regime (CPIAUCSL < 101) predicts a positive 5-day S&P 500 forward return as it signals demand recovery.
failure_condition: 5-day forward return is negative; or consumption growth is not durable beyond one month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly RSAFS (retail sales) decline exceeding 5% while HOUST (building permits) remains flat indicates a structural supply-side weakness that precedes a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS falls > 5% AND HOUST unchanged for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative; or permits rebound while sales remain weak.
